name: cosil_rq3_repair_top15_k10_mimo128k_stream_v8_patch_audit
rerank_test_policy: candidate-independent generated tests are not yet available for this dataset; official F2P/P2P tests are never used for candidate selection
notes: CoSIL RQ3 downstream repair alignment for a localization comparison. The fine localization response now records connected entry points, state transitions, boundary cases, expected files, and line locations across the code path. Repair candidates receive this independently generated plan and full returned locations. Candidate records preserve references to the raw provider response and distinguish response parsing, empty patch, patch application/scope, static validation, truncation, and model filtering. Parsing accepts SEARCH/REPLACE, the documented JSON edits/files schemas, and context-bearing unified diffs; one bounded format-only request is allowed for complete but unsupported formats and never runs after truncation or content filtering. Candidate selection first compares coverage of plan-declared expected files, then normalized majority vote, smaller change, and candidate index; this coverage is diagnostic and cannot establish semantic correctness. Official F2P/P2P tests are never used for candidate selection. Top-15 means up to 15 available ranked files; no rank is fabricated. MiMo-v2.5 deep thinking uses max_completion_tokens=131072 and SSE streaming with include_usage. In MiMo thinking mode, temperature/top_p values are requested values rather than effective decoding controls. The original CoSIL reranker is not imitated with official benchmark tests to avoid evaluation leakage.
